#!/bin/bash
# Edge case / error handling test suite for planb64.
BIN=/work/submit/planb64
W=/tmp/t2/work
rm -rf $W; mkdir -p $W
pass=0; fail=0

ok() { pass=$((pass+1)); }
bad() { fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL: $1"; }

# expect_ok <desc> <cmd...>  : exit 0, empty stderr
expect_ok() {
  local desc="$1"; shift
  local out err rc
  out=$("$@" 2>/tmp/t2/err); rc=$?
  err=$(cat /tmp/t2/err)
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then bad "$desc (rc=$rc, stderr=$err)"; return; fi
  if [ -n "$err" ]; then bad "$desc (stderr not empty: $err)"; return; fi
  ok
}
# expect_err <desc> <cmd...> : rc 2, stderr starts with ERROR:, stdout empty
expect_err() {
  local desc="$1"; shift
  local out err rc
  out=$("$@" 2>/tmp/t2/err); rc=$?
  err=$(cat /tmp/t2/err)
  if [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then bad "$desc (rc=$rc expected 2; stderr=$err)"; return; fi
  if [ -n "$out" ]; then bad "$desc (stdout not empty)"; return; fi
  case "$err" in
    ERROR:*) : ;;
    *) bad "$desc (stderr does not start with ERROR: '$err')"; return;;
  esac
  ok
}
expect_file() {
  local desc="$1" f="$2" content="$3"
  if [ "$(cat $f)" != "$content" ]; then bad "$desc (content mismatch)"; else ok; fi
}

# ---------- build: empty FIB ----------
: > $W/empty.txt
expect_ok "build empty fib" $BIN build $W/empty.txt $W/empty.idx
printf 'PLANB64 1\n1\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\n' > $W/empty.want
if cmp -s $W/empty.idx $W/empty.want; then ok; else bad "empty fib image"; fi

# ---------- build: default route only ----------
printf '::/0 0\n' > $W/def.txt
expect_ok "build default route" $BIN build $W/def.txt $W/def.idx
printf 'PLANB64 1\n1\n0000000000000000 0 0\n' > $W/def.want
if cmp -s $W/def.idx $W/def.want; then ok; else bad "default route image"; cat $W/def.idx; fi

# ---------- build: /64 at the very top of the space ----------
printf 'ffff:ffff:ffff:ffff::/64 4294967295\n' > $W/top.txt
expect_ok "build top /64" $BIN build $W/top.txt $W/top.idx
printf 'PLANB64 1\n2\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\nffffffffffffffff 4294967295 64\n' > $W/top.want
if cmp -s $W/top.idx $W/top.want; then ok; else bad "top /64 image"; cat $W/top.idx; fi

# ---------- build: whitespace, blank lines, uppercase, ipv4 embedded, leading zeros ----------
printf '\n  2001:DB8::/32\t007  \n\n::ffff:1.2.3.4/128 5\n' > $W/ws.txt
expect_err "build /128 rejected" $BIN build $W/ws.txt $W/ws.idx
printf '  2001:DB8::/32\t007  \n\n::ffff:1.2.3.4/64 5\n' > $W/ws.txt
expect_ok "build whitespace/uppercase/leading zeros" $BIN build $W/ws.txt $W/ws.idx
printf 'PLANB64 1\n3\n0000000000000000 -1 -1\n20010db800000000 7 32\n20010db800000001 5 64\n' > $W/ws.want
if cmp -s $W/ws.idx $W/ws.want; then ok; else bad "whitespace image"; cat $W/ws.idx; fi

# ---------- build: duplicate normalised prefix ----------
printf '2001:db8::/32 1\n2001:db8:0:0::/32 2\n' > $W/dup.txt
expect_err "duplicate prefix rejected" $BIN build $W/dup.txt $W/dup.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32 1\n2001:db8::/32 1\n' > $W/dup.txt
expect_err "duplicate prefix same hop rejected" $BIN build $W/dup.txt $W/dup.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32 1\n2001:db8::/16 2\n' > $W/dup.txt
expect_ok "different lengths allowed" $BIN build $W/dup.txt $W/dup.idx

# ---------- build: invalid inputs ----------
printf '2001:db8::/65 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "/65 rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/128 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "/128 rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/-1 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "negative length rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/+32 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "signed length rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32x 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "junk length rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8:: 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "missing length rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '1.2.3.4/32 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "ipv4 only rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf 'fe80::1%%eth0/64 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "zone id rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32 4294967296\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "hop overflow rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32 -1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "negative hop rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32 1 2\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "extra tokens rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "missing hop rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '# comment\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "comment rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32 1x\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "junk hop rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32/64 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "double slash rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf 'gggg::/32 1\n' > $W/bad.txt; expect_err "bad hex rejected" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/o.idx
printf '2001:db8::/32 1\n2001:db9::/32 2\n' > $W/good.txt
expect_ok "good fib" $BIN build $W/good.txt $W/good.idx

# ---------- build: missing input file / unwritable output ----------
expect_err "missing fib file" $BIN build $W/nosuch.txt $W/o.idx
expect_err "missing output dir" $BIN build $W/good.txt $W/nosuchdir/o.idx
expect_err "no args" $BIN
expect_err "build wrong argc" $BIN build $W/good.txt
expect_err "build extra argc" $BIN build $W/good.txt $W/o.idx extra
expect_err "unknown command" $BIN frobnicate a b

# ---------- build: destination untouched on failure ----------
printf 'ORIGINAL\n' > $W/dest.idx
expect_err "failed build" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/dest.idx
expect_file "destination unchanged" $W/dest.idx "ORIGINAL"
printf 'ORIGINAL\n' > $W/dest2.idx
expect_err "failed build (missing file)" $BIN build $W/nosuch.txt $W/dest2.idx
expect_file "destination unchanged 2" $W/dest2.idx "ORIGINAL"
rm -f $W/newdest.idx
expect_err "failed build (new dest)" $BIN build $W/bad.txt $W/newdest.idx
if [ -e $W/newdest.idx ]; then bad "new destination created on failure"; else ok; fi

# ---------- lookup: good image / trace ----------
printf '::\n2001:db8::1\n2001:db8:1::1\nffff:ffff:ffff:ffff::1\n' > $W/trace.txt
expect_ok "lookup scalar" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/trace.txt scalar
printf -- '-1 -1\n20 32\n-1 -1\n-1 -1\n' > $W/trace.want
if [ "$($BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/trace.txt scalar)" = "$(cat $W/trace.want)" ]; then ok; else bad "lookup scalar output"; fi
for b in 1 2 3 4 256 003 00000003; do
  if [ "$($BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/trace.txt batch $b)" = "$(cat $W/trace.want)" ]; then ok; else bad "lookup batch $b output"; fi
done

# ---------- lookup: invalid batch sizes ----------
for b in 0 257 300 -1 +3 " 3" "3 " "" abc 3.0 0x10 1e2; do
  expect_err "bad batch size '$b'" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/trace.txt batch "$b"
done
expect_err "batch without size" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/trace.txt batch
expect_err "scalar with size" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/trace.txt scalar 3
expect_err "unknown mode" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/trace.txt vector
expect_err "lookup missing args" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx
expect_err "lookup missing image" $BIN lookup $W/nosuch.idx $W/trace.txt scalar

# ---------- lookup: invalid trace ----------
printf '1.2.3.4\n' > $W/badtrace.txt; expect_err "ipv4 trace rejected" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/badtrace.txt scalar
printf 'fe80::1%%eth0\n' > $W/badtrace.txt; expect_err "zone trace rejected" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/badtrace.txt scalar
printf '2001:db8::/32\n' > $W/badtrace.txt; expect_err "cidr trace rejected" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/badtrace.txt scalar
printf '2001:db8::1 2001:db8::2\n' > $W/badtrace.txt; expect_err "two tokens trace rejected" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/badtrace.txt scalar
printf 'zzz\n' > $W/badtrace.txt; expect_err "bad address trace rejected" $BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/badtrace.txt scalar
printf '\n\n::\n\n' > $W/blanktrace.txt
if [ "$($BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/blanktrace.txt scalar)" = "-1 -1" ]; then ok; else bad "blank trace"; fi
: > $W/notrace.txt
if [ "$($BIN lookup $W/good.idx $W/notrace.txt scalar)" = "" ]; then ok; else bad "empty trace"; fi

echo "pass=$pass fail=$fail"
SH
chmod +x /tmp/t2/run.sh && /tmp/t2/run.sh
